name: Glama
short: AI gateway and ecosystem for Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations with free evaluation credits.

plans.name: Free Plan
plans.notes: Default plan on signup ($0/mo, no credit card required). Includes 1,000 monthly credits and API keys to connect MCP tool servers, run inspection workflows, and route LLM calls in your own environment.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Higher concurrency, shared team workspaces, dedicated endpoints, and scaled token volume for production agents.
